# AttendKH — Complete Workforce Management & Cambodian Payroll Platform Documentation
# Canonical Source: https://attendkh.com/llms-full.txt

> AttendKH is the premier cloud-and-mobile workforce management platform built specifically for businesses, enterprises, and institutions in the Kingdom of Cambodia. It combines point-in-time GPS geofencing, selfie anti-buddy punching, offline queueing, and an automated dual-currency (USD & KHR) payroll engine strictly aligned with Cambodian Labour Law and MoLVT regulations.

## 2. Core Functional Modules

### A. Point-in-Time GPS Geofencing
- **Configurable Radius**: 50 meters to 200 meters configurable per branch, boutique, kitchen, construction site, or satellite warehouse.
- **Zero 24/7 Background Tracking**: GPS coordinates are requested strictly and exclusively at the split-second when the employee presses "Clock In" or "Clock Out". Zero continuous device location tracking occurs, preserving employee battery and privacy.
- **Anti-Spoofing Verification**: Checks for mock location providers, developer simulation flags, and GPS emulator signatures on both iOS and Android.

### B. Live Selfie Anti-Buddy Punching
- **Camera Capture**: Live selfie snapshot paired with exact GPS coordinates and device timestamp.
- **Offline Storage**: Selfies and timestamps are encrypted with AES-256 locally on the device when cellular or Wi-Fi data is unavailable.
- **Automatic Queue Sync**: Automatically uploads queued attendance records in sequence as soon as an internet connection is re-established.

### C. Tablet QR Kiosk Mode
- **Shared Terminal**: Any standard iPad or Android tablet can be mounted at branch entrances or warehouse doors as a central attendance kiosk.
- **QR Dynamic Badges**: Staff scan their personal dynamic mobile QR code or ID badge to record arrival and departure times without needing individual company-issued phones.

---

## 3. Cambodian Labour Law Compliance Engine

AttendKH eliminates manual spreadsheet calculation errors by baking Cambodian Ministry of Labour and Vocational Training (MoLVT) regulations directly into the payroll engine.

### A. Overtime Multipliers (Cambodian Labour Law)
- **Normal Working Hours**: Maximum 8 hours per day, 48 hours per week.
- **Standard Overtime (Daytime)**: 1.5× hourly base wage rate for hours exceeding standard shifts between 06:00 and 22:00.
- **Night Overtime**: 2.0× hourly base wage rate for work performed between 22:00 and 06:00.
- **Weekly Rest Day & Public Holidays**: 2.0× hourly base wage rate for work conducted on Sundays or official government public holidays listed in the annual MoLVT Prakas.

### B. Seniority Indemnity (MoLVT Prakas No. 443/18)
- **UDC (Undetermined Duration Contracts)**: Mandates 15 days of actual wages and fringe benefits per year, disbursed semiannually:
  - 7.5 days paid at the end of the first semester (June).
  - 7.5 days paid at the end of the second semester (December).
  - Continuous service between 1 and 6 continuous months in a semester guarantees a full 7.5-day entitlement (not prorated).
- **FDC (Fixed Duration Contracts)**: Exempt from Seniority Indemnity, but legally requires a minimum 5% statutory severance indemnity payment upon contract conclusion.

### C. NSSF (ប.ស.ស. - National Social Security Fund) Formulas
AttendKH automatically computes monthly NSSF contributions according to statutory ceilings:
1. **Occupational Risk Scheme**: 0.8% paid 100% by the employer.
2. **Health Care Scheme**: 2.6% paid 100% by the employer.
3. **Pension Scheme**:
   - 2.0% employer contribution.
   - 2.0% employee contribution deducted from gross salary.
   - Calculated up to the statutory wage ceiling promulgated by the Ministry.

### D. Dual-Currency USD & KHR Architecture
- **Multi-Currency Display**: Staff and management can toggle contracts and payslips between US Dollars ($) and Khmer Riel (៛).
- **Exchange Rate Configuration**: Custom or National Bank of Cambodia (NBC) daily official exchange rates.
- **Bilingual Payslips**: Every payslip renders in both English and Khmer with clear line-item breakdowns of basic wage, overtime, allowances, seniority pay, NSSF deductions, and net payable.

### E. Banking Batch Export Formats
AttendKH generates pre-formatted batch payroll files ready for direct upload to Cambodian financial institutions:
- **ABA Bank**: ABA PayWay and corporate mass payroll CSV/Excel template.
- **ACLEDA Bank**: ACLEDA ToanChet enterprise bulk payroll format.
- **Canadia Bank**: Corporate direct settlement file.
- **Wing Bank**: Wing corporate enterprise disbursement file.
- **Bakong KHQR**: Integrated settlement support for local bank-to-bank payroll distribution.

---

## 4. Multi-Branch Architecture & Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)

- **Super Admin / Business Owner**: Global visibility across all branches, aggregate payroll reporting, audit logs, and master settings.
- **HR / Payroll Manager**: Configures shift schedules, leave requests, tax brackets, and bank export files.
- **Branch Supervisor / Store Manager**: Manages daily roster, approves real-time manual punch adjustments, and views on-site employee presence.
- **Staff / Employee**: Mobile access on iOS and Android to clock in/out, view personal timecards, check remaining annual leave balances, and download monthly payslips.

---

## 5. Pricing Structure

AttendKH offers a transparent, all-in-one pricing model designed for Cambodian enterprises of any scale:

- **Monthly Subscription**: **$1.00 USD per active user per month** (approximately 4,100 KHR).
- **Annual Subscription**: Discounted annual billing available with 2 months free ($10.00 USD per user per year).
- **Zero Tier Restrictions**: All features — GPS geofencing, selfie anti-spoofing, multi-branch control, automated payroll, NSSF formulas, and bank batch exports — are fully unlocked on every plan.
- **No Setup or Hidden Fees**: Free cloud onboarding, complimentary training for HR managers in Phnom Penh, and ongoing support via Telegram.
